text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's victory is hotly anticipated as the autumn Tenno Sho is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intent on defeating her, Super Creek finishes practicing for her role as the villain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads over to the racecourse to stir up the crowd at the autumn Tenno Sho.
